name: gfx_texture
doc: Where a texture's content is, one instance per live texture (src/gfx/texcontent.ts). WebAssembly cannot protect pages, so CPU writes to texture storage are not seen as they happen (nxnative nvn_dirty.c); the state is checked when a submission first needs the texture. Unknown: the host texture holds nothing the recorder vouches for; its first use uploads the storage (deswizzled). Uploaded carries the sampled hash of the storage it was uploaded from: at the first use in each later submission the sampled hash is taken again (and the full hash when the range was flushed, or periodically within a budget), and a difference is Stale: uploaded again. GpuOwned: a render pass, a copy or a clear wrote it; guest memory no longer describes it and it is never uploaded again.
